newsitem.title: UK: British groups welcome call for regulatory clarity.
newsitem.headline: British groups welcome call for regulatory clarity.

text.p: The Confederation of British Industry (CBI) and the main opposition Labour party welcomed a call for more transparency and accountability in privatised UK utility regulation made in a report on the sector published on Tuesday.

The report from the independent Commission on the Regulation of Privatised Utilities had highlighted complaints over "a lack of clarity and transparency concerning the arguments and justification" underlying regulatory decisions.
The CBI said in a statement that it welcomed the report's recommendations to clarify duties of the regulators and to set up advisory boards to publish advice given to the regulator.
Opposition Labour party energy spokesman John Battle said the report showed that there was "an increasing consensus that there is a need to reform the system of utility regulation."
